name: [👻]99 Nights in the Wild West🌵
desc:
🏕You’re a bounty hunter, riding into this mysterious, uncharted part of the Wild West. 
🔫Your job? Track down 4 real bad, real high-value outlaws!
👀But besides the crooks, gold, and oil around here, there’s somethin’ down-right scary hidin’ in the dark...

🥰 Game inspired by "99 Nights in the Forest" 🌲🌙

Welcome to report bugs in the group.

[Bug Fixed]
We fixed the mobile bug where dying or reviving could make your joystick disappear and leave your character stuck jumping.

Sorry for the frustration, especially if it cost you a revive or progress.

Thanks for reporting it!
